messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: high-sev customer impact (Zenith Corp) - error spike in dedicated VPC. Please acknowledge. thread_ts=1893456789

Asha Patel: acknowledged. I'm oncall for infra. Pulling logs now. Any initial customer-reported symptoms?

Devon Kim: Zenith reported malformed responses and repeated auth failures around 18:22 UTC. Their dedicated pool (pool-zenith-2) shows elevated token errors and a surge in debug-level logs.

Priya Shah: I'm with support — customer says they need us to run forensics on their recent requests. They specifically asked we search for some email addresses and session tokens in logs. They also asked if we can temporarily bypass redaction for the query to find a root cause.

Asha Patel: Do NOT bypass redaction without legal + customer written approval. We can do a scoped, timeboxed exception with audit trails. Spinning up a forensics node in their VPC to run queries against a read-only copy is possible.

Luis Ortega: FYI their pool is in a private VPC with tenant isolation. We can export the affected shard logs to a tmp bucket in their VPC, run `redact-run` with strict filter, and then destroy the copy.

legal-ops: Assign to us. We need: (1) exact fields they want to search, (2) justification, (3) explicit written consent from Zenith technical contact, and (4) retention window for the extracted data. No broad redaction disable allowed.

Priya Shah: Zenith's security lead (security@zenith.example) sent an email approving a limited search for the session IDs they provided. They want us to search 2026-03-15T18:00:00Z -> 2026-03-15T19:00:00Z and send results to their S3. They asked if we can keep copies for internal debugging for 48 hours.

Asha Patel: Request logged. Legal signoff still needed in thread. Devon/Luis, can you outline the steps we would take and where the redaction exceptions would be applied?

Devon Kim: Proposed flow: 1) Create read-only snapshot of the pool logs to s3://zenith-incident-1893456789 (in their VPC). 2) Launch ephemeral forensics node in customer VPC with restricted IAM role and EKS pod that mounts that bucket. 3) Run targeted search script that only looks for the provided session IDs/email hashes. 4) Apply a transformation pipeline that masks everything except the matched keys; all outputs are redacted by default, except white-listed matches. 5) Upload a results bundle and destroy the snapshot + node.

Luis Ortega: Technical notes: we'll never flip global redaction off. The pipeline uses a scope-limited exception list (an allowlist) and we log every read operation to audit. We'll also set object lifecycle on the S3 to expire after 7 days unless legal approves extension.

legal-ops: That's closer. A few clarifications: a) "allowlist" must be narrowly scoped to the exact session IDs or SHA256 hashes provided by the customer. b) Internal copies kept by Redwood may be retained for a maximum of 48 hours unless an exception is filed with log of approver and justification. c) All actions must be recorded in the incident ticket and include signoffs. d) We need customer to CC their legal on the approval email.

Priya Shah: Zenith has CC'd their legal and given explicit consent. They confirmed they want us to run the search and share the results back into their S3 with server-side encryption.

Asha Patel: Good. Devon/Luis, proceed with a timeboxed exception. Post the exact commands/config you will run and the IAM role names here before executing. I'll be monitoring.

Devon Kim: Command plan (will not run until legal-ops OK):
```
# create export (read-only)
redwood logs export --tenant zenith --pool pool-zenith-2 --since "2026-03-15T18:00:00Z" --until "2026-03-15T19:00:00Z" --destination s3://zenith-incident-1893456789 --redact=on

# forensics pod (read-only IAM role)
kubectl run forensics-zenith --image=redwood/forensics:stable --env REDIS=false --attach=false --command -- /bin/sh -c "./search --ids-file ids.txt --out results.json"
```
Devon Kim: Redaction config snippet we'll use on the pipeline (only allow exact matches):
```
redaction_policy:
  mode: allowlist
  allowlist_keys:
    - sha256:3a4f... (session-id-1)
    - sha256:7f1b... (session-id-2)
  mask_before_after: true
```

Luis Ortega: IAM role: arn:aws:iam::XXXXX:role/zenith-forensics-readonly (policy scoped to s3://zenith-incident-1893456789/* and logs:get). Pod runs in customer's VPC subnet with no internet egress.

legal-ops: I confirm legal review complete. Conditions: 1) Redwood internal retention = 48 hours; 2) Customer copy retention TTL = 7 days (customer can request longer); 3) All accesses produce an immutable audit event; 4) Ops engineer must post a post-incident redaction audit to the ticket. Approved by legal-ops @sarah (see internal ticket).

Asha Patel: Legal signoff noted. Proceeding with execution in 5 mins. Devon, create the incident artifact in the console and tag with `redaction-exception:zenith-1893456789` and `legal-approved:true`.

Devon Kim: Artifact created. Starting export now. ETA approx 12m.

incidents-bot: :white_check_mark: Export job started (job_id=exp-1893456789). Will post completion status.

Priya Shah: I'll keep Zenith updated and will share the S3 path and encryption info once results land.

Asha Patel: Once the results are in, do not upload raw files to internal slack. Share a summary and the secure S3 link only. After 48 hours, internal copies will be destroyed; customer copy will expire per TTL.

Luis Ortega: Export job completed successfully and results landed in s3://zenith-incident-1893456789/results.json (encrypted). Running verification and audit log finalization.

Devon Kim: Verification done. Only matches for the provided session IDs were present. No other PII was exposed. Deleting ephemeral pod and snapshot now.

incidents-bot: :lock: Forensics environment destroyed. job_id=exp-1893456789, destroyed_at=1893460990

legal-ops: Please attach the signed email from Zenith and the internal approver to the ticket before closing. Also route a short summary to compliance for record.

Priya Shah: Uploaded customer consent and legal signoff to the ticket. Notifying Zenith that internal copies will be removed per policy.

Asha Patel: Incident mitigated for Zenith. Closing on-call handoff in 10. Good coordination everyone. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Handoff acknowledged. Will monitor pool-zenith-2 for next 2 hours for any regression.

incidents-bot: thread closed (archived) - incident-1893456789
